message.content:
The crystal is described in space group number [[param:space_group.number]], with the Hall symbol [[param:space_group.hall]]. The input structure contains [[param:input.atom_count]] atoms in total, comprising [[param:composition.Kr]] and [[param:composition.F]].

The original input cell is specified by lattice parameters [[param:cell.a]], [[param:cell.b]], and [[param:cell.c]], with interaxial angles [[param:cell.alpha]], [[param:cell.beta]], and [[param:cell.gamma]]. This input cell is transformed into the standard crystallographic frame using the matrix [[param:frame.matrix]] together with the origin shift [[param:frame.origin_shift]]. Fractional coordinates in the input description are rounded to [[param:round_digits]] decimal places.

In the standard frame, the independent atomic content is represented by two Wyckoff orbits. The krypton atoms occupy orbit [[param:orbit.o000.id]], with element [[param:orbit.o000.element]] on Wyckoff position [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]]. The fluorine atoms occupy orbit [[param:orbit.o001.id]], with element [[param:orbit.o001.element]] on Wyckoff position [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]], and this orbit carries the free coordinate [[param:orbit.o001.parameters]]. No precision corrections are supplied, so the description contains no additional deviations from the idealized backbone beyond the stated structural parameters.
